title: Beutler-Fano asymmetric profile from discrete-continuum interference
expression_sketch: Fano 1961 cross-section: sigma ≈ (q*Gamma_res/2 + E - E_res)**2 / ((Gamma_res/2)**2 + (E - E_res)**2). Reduced energy: epsilon = 2*(E - E_res)/Gamma_res, equivalently epsilon = 2*(E - E_F)/Gamma. One-parameter family: sigma / sigma_background = (epsilon + q)**2 / (epsilon**2 + 1). Window member q = 0: sigma ≈ (E - E_res)**2 / ((Gamma_res/2)**2 + (E - E_res)**2). Lorentzian/Breit-Wigner member |q| -> oo (direct amplitude vanishes relative to resonant). Zero of the profile at epsilon = -q; maximum at epsilon = 1/q for q != 0. Resonant energy E_res is required to lie in the energy range of the continuum (background) states.
latent_structure: A one-parameter family of rational response profiles indexed by the Fano q, with a shared quadratic denominator (E - E_res)**2 + (Gamma_res/2)**2. The q = 0 window, finite-q asymmetric line, and |q| -> oo Lorentzian are members of that family (piecewise unification of discrete-plus-continuum interference), not CSE of numerator and denominator. Consistent with Feshbach-Fano partitioning but packaged here as the published lineshape, not as the optical Hamiltonian.

E_res.notes: resonant energy; Wikipedia also writes E_F

Gamma_res.notes: line width of the resonant energy as written

q.notes: Fano parameter: ratio of resonant scattering to direct (background) scattering amplitude

function_domains.sigma: total scattering cross-section near the autoionizing / Fano resonance

nonzero_conditions.statement: The profile denominator is (Gamma_res/2)**2 + (E - E_res)**2; equivalently epsilon**2 + 1 after reducing by Gamma_res/2
nonzero_conditions.label: DECLARED
nonzero_conditions.source: Wikipedia Fano resonance, Explanation: sigma ≈ (q Gamma_res/2 + E - E_res)**2 / ((Gamma_res/2)**2 + (E - E_res)**2)

analytic_domains.statement: The energy of the resonant state must lie in the energy range of the continuum (background) states for the effect to occur
analytic_domains.label: DECLARED
analytic_domains.source: Wikipedia Fano resonance, Explanation: 'The energy of the resonant state must lie in the energy range of the continuum (background) states for the effect to occur'

analytic_domains.statement: Near E_res the background amplitude varies slowly while the resonant amplitude changes magnitude and phase quickly; within 2 Gamma_res of E_res the resonant phase changes by pi
analytic_domains.label: DECLARED
analytic_domains.source: Wikipedia Fano resonance, Explanation, paragraphs on phase variation

analytic_domains.statement: If the direct scattering amplitude vanishes, q = 0 and the formula becomes the symmetric window (E - E_res)**2 / ((Gamma_res/2)**2 + (E - E_res)**2)
analytic_domains.label: DECLARED
analytic_domains.source: Wikipedia Fano resonance: 'In case the direct scattering amplitude vanishes, the q parameter becomes zero and the Fano formula becomes' the window expression

analytic_domains.statement: Transmission 1 - sigma(q=0) recovers the three-parameter Lorentzian / Breit-Wigner profile
analytic_domains.label: DECLARED
analytic_domains.source: Wikipedia Fano resonance: 'this last expression boils down to the expected Breit-Wigner (Lorentzian) formula'

branch_conventions: q measures resonant versus direct amplitude as written; q = 0 is the window member, |q| large is the Lorentzian member.
Reduced energy epsilon = 2*(E - E_res)/Gamma_res (Miroshnichenko et al. restatement of Fano 1961).

limit_domains.statement: The |q| -> infinity limit of the family is the standard Lorentzian of a Breit-Wigner resonance (direct continuum transition weak)
limit_domains.label: DECLARED
limit_domains.source: Miroshnichenko, Flach, Kivshar, Rev. Mod. Phys. 82 (2010) 2257, arXiv:0902.3014, discussion of (1): 'In the limit |q| -> infinity, Eq. (1) reduces to the standard Lorentzian profile of a Breit-Wigner resonance'

source_provenance: Miroshnichenko, A. E., Flach, S., Kivshar, Y. S., Rev. Mod. Phys. 82 (2010) 2257, arXiv:0902.3014

derived_conditions.statement: sigma_min = 0 at epsilon = -q and sigma_max = 1 + q**2 at epsilon = 1/q (for the normalised (epsilon+q)**2/(epsilon**2+1) family)
derived_conditions.label: DERIVED
derived_conditions.source: Critical points of (epsilon+q)**2/(epsilon**2+1); recorded in Miroshnichenko et al., arXiv:0902.3014, eq. (2)

public_source: Wikipedia, Fano resonance (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fano_resonance); Fano, Phys. Rev. 124, 1866 (1961), doi:10.1103/PhysRev.124.1866; Miroshnichenko-Flach-Kivshar, arXiv:0902.3014.
why_not_cse_lgg: CSE can share the Lorentzian denominator. LGG antiunifies a window and a peak. The scientific object is a q-family unifying discrete-continuum interference, with written domain that E_res lies in the continuum band.
proposer_leak_risk: Do not plant 'Fano', 'Beutler', or 'autoionization' as gold names. Keep distinct from the Feshbach optical Hamiltonian case packaged separately in this directory.
notes: Not Lippmann-Schwinger, not Lehmann, not Kato simple eigenvalue. Real-energy lineshape; no folklore i epsilon. Overlap of a discrete state with a continuum is written as a necessary condition. Complementary to rps-r-feshbach-optical-heff (operator Schur complement vs published profile). is_guo=false.
